create.name: Katchie Ananda
create.bio:
Katchie Ananda is a yoga and dharma teacher who has taught yoga full time since 1991. Her training spans several schools: she holds certifications in Integral, Jivamukti and Anusara yoga and completed Ashtanga trainings with Richard Freeman, and on the Buddhist side she studied Theravada practice with Jack Kornfield. In San Francisco she co-founded the studio Yoga Sangha, later known as Yoga Kula, and over the years she has led teacher trainings, workshops and festival sessions in many countries.

She calls her approach the Art of Awakening, joining physical practice with meditation, chanting, storytelling and short talks on a weekly theme drawn from yogic and Buddhist teaching. Students often mention her humour and directness. Much of her teaching is now online: her Patreon community receives a short dharma talk or guided meditation and a forty-minute themed yoga class each week, and she also teaches for the German platform YogaEasy. Her book The Art of Awakening, sold as an ebook through her website, gathers practices, stories and poetry from her years of teaching. She is now based in the Pacific Northwest.
